cards.title: Add a second account in **4 taps**

steps.title: Open Profile
steps.text: Tap Profile in the bottom bar.

steps.title: New email or phone

steps.title: Remove it
steps.text: Tap the trash icon or Remove.

steps.title: New password
steps.text: So they can’t sign back in.

steps.title: 2-step verification
steps.text: Turn it on in the same menu.

cards.name: bottom-line
cards.quote: Run as many accounts as you have sign-ins. **Never use one to dodge a ban.**
